messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 13):
"""
2.4.1 Target population [This section should discuss the target market for which the product is designed. Also please enclose separately the details of any market research conducted for this purpose.] 2.4.2 Whether Grace period allowed for renewal— specify the number of days allowed for renewal of the contract and also specify whether insurance coverage is continued S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by insurer) till the date of receipt of renewal premium during the grace period 2.4.3 Grace period allowed for payment of premiums in instalments— specify the number of days allowed for payment of premium when premiums are not paid on stipulated dates. 2.4.4 Basic Sum Insured (in IN R): 2.4.4.1 Minimum offered 2.4.4.2 Maximum offered 2.4.5 Policy Period:
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What is the grace period allowed for renewal of a health insurance contract and does coverage continue during this period?","answer":"The grace period for renewal is specified in the policy, and coverage continues until the receipt of the renewal premium during that grace period.","facts":["2.4.2 Whether Grace period allowed for renewal— specify the number of days allowed for renewal of the contract","and also specify whether insurance coverage is continued S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by insurer) till the date of receipt of renewal premium during the grace period"]},{"question":"What is the grace period allowed for payment of premiums in instalments?","answer":"The policy specifies the number of days allowed for payment of premium when premiums are not paid on stipulated dates.","facts":["2.4.3 Grace period allowed for payment of premiums in instalments— specify the number of days allowed for payment of premium when premiums are not paid on stipulated dates"]}]}
